source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Follows the pinned future we will give and retains the bride's own preparation.
key_decisions.before: Let us rejoice and exult and give him the glory, for the marriage of the Lamb has come, and his bride has made herself ready;
key_decisions.after: Let us rejoice and be glad, and we will give him glory, because the Lamb's wedding has come, and his wife has prepared herself.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Let us rejoice and exult and give him the glory, for the marriage of the Lamb has come, and his bride has made herself ready;

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the rejected worship and both open testimony-of-Jesus expressions.
key_decisions.before: Then I fell down at his feet to worship him, but he said to me, “Do not do that! I am a servant with you and your brothers and sisters who hold the testimony of Jesus. Worship God! For the testimony of Jesus[b] is the spirit of prophecy.”
key_decisions.after: I fell at his feet to worship him, but he said, “Do not do that! I am a fellow slave with you and your brothers and sisters who hold the testimony of Jesus. Worship God! For the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Then I fell down at his feet to worship him, but he said to me, “Do not do that! I am a servant with you and your brothers and sisters who hold the testimony of Jesus. Worship God! For the testimony of Jesus[b] is the spirit of prophecy.”

key_decisions.rationale: Follows the direct eyes-as-flame wording and keeps the undisclosed name.
key_decisions.before: His eyes are like a flame of fire, and on his head are many diadems, and he has a name written that no one knows but himself.
key_decisions.after: His eyes are a flame of fire, and on his head are many royal crowns. He has a name written that no one knows except himself.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: His eyes are like a flame of fire, and on his head are many diadems, and he has a name written that no one knows but himself.

key_decisions.rationale: Follows dipped rather than sprinkled and does not identify whose blood.
key_decisions.before: He is clothed in a robe dipped in blood, and the name by which he is called is the Word of God.
key_decisions.after: He is dressed in a robe dipped in blood, and his name is called the Word of God.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: He is clothed in a robe dipped in blood, and the name by which he is called is the Word of God.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves repeated flesh and every social group without sanitizing the gruesome feast.
key_decisions.before: to eat the flesh of kings, the flesh of captains, the flesh of mighty men, the flesh of horses and their riders, and the flesh of all men, both free and slave, both small and great.”
key_decisions.after: to eat the flesh of kings, the flesh of military commanders, the flesh of the powerful, the flesh of horses and their riders, and the flesh of everyone, free and slave, small and great.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: to eat the flesh of kings, the flesh of captains, the flesh of mighty men, the flesh of horses and their riders, and the flesh of all men, both free and slave, both small and great.”

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves capture, the deception's recipients and the explicit alive.
key_decisions.before: And the beast was captured, and with it the false prophet who in its presence had done the signs by which he deceived people who had received the mark of the beast and people who worshiped its image. These two were thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with sulfur.
key_decisions.after: The beast was captured, and with it the false prophet who had performed signs in its presence, deceiving those who received the beast's mark and worshiped its image. The two were thrown alive into the lake of fire burning with sulfur.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And the beast was captured, and with it the false prophet who in its presence had done the signs by which he deceived those who had received the mark of the beast and those who worshiped its image. These two were thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with sulfur.
